description: Projects cash month by month from current cash, revenue growth and expense growth: net burn, runway, the month cash hits zero, break-even month, default alive or dead, burn multiple, and the same with an expense cut. Same math as https://modevc.com/tools/burn-multiple-runway. Month 1 is the current month; the search runs 120 months.

as_of_date.description: Date that month 1 falls in, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. Only used for calendar month labels.

cash.description: Cash in the bank in USD. Web default 2,400,000.

expense_cut_pct.description: Expense cut scenario in percent. Web default 15.

expense_growth_pct.description: Monthly expense growth in percent. Web default 2.

monthly_expenses.description: Current monthly expenses in USD. Web default 210,000.

monthly_revenue.description: Current monthly revenue (MRR) in USD. Web default 60,000.

net_new_arr_override.description: Net new ARR over the quarter in USD. Omit to compute it from revenue growth, as the web calculator does.

quarterly_net_burn_override.description: Net burn over the quarter in USD. Omit to use 3 times this month's net burn.

revenue_growth_pct.description: Monthly revenue growth in percent. Web default 8.

name: calc_burn_multiple_runway
title: Burn Multiple and Runway Calculator
